steps.name: Given TPP have a valid PayPal access token
When TPP create a checkout order using data from excel for "ORDER_1"
Then TPP check order is succesfully created with "200"
And TPP confirm the checkout order and response code should be "200" and "ORDER_1"
Then TPP redirect PSU to login on paypal  to approve the order with "id4@gmail.com" and "idan4@123"

steps.name: And PSU select account "Visa" on accounts page and submit the payment
Then TPP authorize order after user approval through paypal with payload "ORDER_1_AUTH" and response code should be "201"
And the order status should be "COMPLETED"
